provenance.note: GPD maximum likelihood by Nelder-Mead on (ln beta, xi) from scipy's genpareto.fit with the location fixed at zero, asserted to agree with scipy within 1e-3; the 90% profile-likelihood interval by brentq on the chi-square(1) line; the pooled shape by bounded minimisation of the concentrated likelihood with each name's scale set to its mean excess times (1 - xi).
